verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents real-time event streaming and observability (webhook streaming, execution/token tracking, tracing) but these are largely enterprise/AMP features focused on system-to-system monitoring, not a documented developer-facing API for streaming individual LLM tokens or step/tool-call events directly into a custom UI. Missing for 10: explicit token-level streaming API/callback hooks for tool-call and step events, open-source (non-enterprise) support for this, and any hands-on confirmation of UI-facing streaming.
